name: Triangle
description: Three corners were never enough, so this one has four. A regular tetrahedron, every face an equilateral triangle, every face a different color.

name: Circle
description: A circle that gave up on being flat. Approximated by 440 triangles and a firm belief that squinting helps. Painted in latitude bands.

name: Pentagon
description: A pentagonal pyramid with alternating side colors and a grey base to sit on. Sturdy, symmetrical, and slightly smug about it.
